modules.name: Project Delivery & Coordination
modules.description: Cross-cutting planning, communication, and delivery coordination for the platform.

tasks.title: Project management and stakeholder coordination
tasks.description: Coordinate delivery planning, scope decisions, dependencies, stakeholder communication, and release readiness across the project.
tasks.rationale: Cross-functional delivery coordination is required to deliver the stated scope and resolve open implementation decisions.

modules.name: Platform Foundations
modules.description: Shared environments, deployment automation, and quality practices for the platform.

tasks.title: Set up environments and CI/CD
tasks.description: Configure development, test, and production environments, deployment pipelines, and operational configuration for the platform.
tasks.rationale: Environment setup and CI/CD are necessary delivery foundations even though they are not explicit user-facing requirements.

tasks.title: Platform QA and regression testing
tasks.description: Plan and execute cross-platform functional, integration, and regression testing, including release verification.
tasks.rationale: QA and regression coverage are required to validate the integrated platform and prevent regressions across modules.

tasks.title: Cross-platform code review
tasks.description: Review implementation changes for correctness, maintainability, security, and consistency with agreed platform conventions.
tasks.rationale: Code review is a necessary hidden engineering activity across the project.

modules.name: Back-office Operations
modules.description: Administrative interface and supporting services for managing orders, couriers, and vans.

tasks.title: Design back-office admin workflows
tasks.description: Design the admin information architecture, screens, and interaction patterns for managing orders, couriers, and vans.
tasks.rationale: Admin workflows need usable, consistent designs before implementation.

tasks.title: Build back-office admin interface
tasks.description: Implement the back-office screens and interactions for viewing and managing orders, couriers, and vans.
tasks.rationale: The requested admin interface requires frontend implementation for the specified operational entities.

tasks.title: Implement admin management APIs
tasks.description: Implement backend endpoints and business logic to manage orders, couriers, and vans for the back-office interface.
tasks.rationale: The admin interface requires backend CRUD and management services for the stated entities.

modules.name: Dispatcher Live Map
modules.description: Dispatcher dashboard showing courier positions on a live map.

tasks.title: Design dispatcher map dashboard
tasks.description: Design the dispatcher dashboard layout and map interactions for monitoring courier positions.
tasks.rationale: The live-map dashboard needs clear dispatcher workflows and map-focused interaction design.

tasks.title: Build live-map dashboard UI
tasks.description: Implement the dispatcher dashboard map view and courier-position display, including frontend updates from available location data.
tasks.rationale: A frontend dashboard is required to display courier positions to dispatchers.

tasks.title: Implement courier location services
tasks.description: Implement backend services to receive, maintain, and provide courier position data to the dispatcher dashboard, with appropriate update handling.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard needs a backend location-data path to provide courier positions; update frequency and source require confirmation.

modules.name: Microsoft Dynamics Integration
modules.description: Import orders from Microsoft Dynamics and synchronize delivery status, limited to the stated integration scope.

tasks.title: Define Dynamics integration mapping
tasks.description: Document and validate field mappings, status mappings, and integration flows for order import and delivery-status synchronization.
tasks.rationale: The integration requires agreed data and status mappings; the brief does not specify schemas or synchronization mechanics.

tasks.title: Implement Dynamics order import
tasks.description: Build the integration flow to import orders from Microsoft Dynamics into the platform.
tasks.rationale: Order import is explicitly included in the ERP integration scope.

tasks.title: Implement delivery-status synchronization
tasks.description: Build the integration flow to synchronize delivery status from the platform to Microsoft Dynamics, using agreed mappings and error handling.
tasks.rationale: Delivery-status synchronization is explicitly included; direction and detailed behavior should be confirmed during integration design.

tasks.title: Test Dynamics integration
tasks.description: Validate order import and delivery-status synchronization with integration tests and agreed test data.
tasks.rationale: External-system flows need dedicated integration testing to verify mappings and failure handling.

modules.name: Routing and ETA Integration
modules.description: Mapping-service integration for routing and estimated arrival times without assuming a provider.

tasks.title: Integrate mapping service for routes and ETAs
tasks.description: Integrate with the selected mapping service to request routes and estimated arrival times and expose results to platform workflows.
tasks.rationale: Routing and ETA support is explicitly required, while provider selection and API details remain unspecified.

tasks.title: Display routes and ETAs
tasks.description: Implement frontend presentation of route and estimated-arrival information in relevant operational views, based on agreed workflows.
tasks.rationale: Mapping results need to be presented to users; the exact screens and interaction details are not specified.

tasks.title: Test routing and ETA integration
tasks.description: Verify mapping-service requests, route results, ETA handling, and expected error states using the selected provider's test facilities.
tasks.rationale: Third-party mapping behavior and failure cases require integration validation.

tasks.title: Define notification content and triggers
tasks.description: Define notification templates, delivery channels, and triggering events for customer SMS and email notifications.
tasks.rationale: Notification content and trigger behavior need definition; the brief does not specify message types or templates.

tasks.title: Implement SMS and email delivery
tasks.description: Implement backend notification workflows and integrate with selected SMS and email delivery providers.
tasks.rationale: The platform must send notifications through both channels; provider selection and delivery rules are unspecified.

tasks.title: Test customer notifications
tasks.description: Test notification triggers, message rendering, and delivery outcomes for SMS and email.
tasks.rationale: Both channels and their trigger behavior need validation, including provider integration paths.

modules.name: Courier Mobile Screens & Proof of Delivery
modules.description: Courier-facing mobile screens supporting proof-of-delivery photos, without assuming a new native app or additional mobile capabilities.

tasks.title: Design courier mobile screens
tasks.description: Design the courier-facing screens and photo-capture interaction needed to support proof of delivery.
tasks.rationale: The required screens and photo workflow need design; whether they belong in a new native app or an existing app is unresolved.

tasks.title: Implement courier mobile screens
tasks.description: Implement the courier-facing mobile screens and proof-of-delivery photo capture flow in the agreed app context.
tasks.rationale: Courier mobile screens are in scope, but the brief does not establish whether a new native app or an existing app is intended.

tasks.title: Implement proof-of-delivery photo handling
tasks.description: Implement backend upload and association of proof-of-delivery photos with the relevant delivery record.
tasks.rationale: Captured photos need a backend path to be stored and associated with deliveries; retention and storage details require confirmation.

tasks.title: Test courier proof-of-delivery flow
tasks.description: Validate the courier screens and photo submission flow on the agreed mobile app context and supported devices.
tasks.rationale: The mobile photo workflow needs end-to-end validation; device and app-context coverage depend on scope confirmation.

modules.name: KPI Reporting & Export
modules.description: KPI dashboard and Excel export for operational reporting.

tasks.title: Design KPI dashboard and export experience
tasks.description: Define KPI dashboard layouts, report filters, and the user flow for exporting data to Excel.
tasks.rationale: Reporting needs clear presentation and export interactions; KPI definitions and filters are not specified.

tasks.title: Implement KPI data and Excel export
tasks.description: Implement reporting data aggregation and backend generation or delivery of Excel exports based on agreed KPI definitions.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard and export require report data services; KPI formulas and data scope need confirmation.

tasks.title: Build KPI dashboard and export UI
tasks.description: Implement the KPI reporting dashboard and user controls for requesting Excel exports.
tasks.rationale: The requested reporting dashboard and export controls require frontend implementation.

tasks.title: Test KPI reports and Excel export
tasks.description: Validate KPI calculations against agreed definitions and verify exported Excel files and dashboard behavior.
tasks.rationale: Report correctness and export usability require dedicated validation.

tasks.title: Define spreadsheet import format and validation
tasks.description: Specify supported spreadsheet structure, field mapping, validation rules, and user feedback for historical order imports.
tasks.rationale: Spreadsheet import requires a defined format and validation behavior, neither of which is specified in the brief.

tasks.title: Implement historical spreadsheet import
tasks.description: Build the import process to parse supported spreadsheets, validate records, and load historical orders into the platform.
tasks.rationale: Historical spreadsheet import is explicitly required; source formats and data quality are unknown.

tasks.title: Build spreadsheet import interface
tasks.description: Implement the user interface for selecting and submitting spreadsheets and reviewing import results or validation errors.
tasks.rationale: An operational import flow needs a user-facing way to submit files and inspect outcomes; exact workflow is not specified.

tasks.title: Test historical order imports
tasks.description: Test supported spreadsheet formats, validation behavior, and successful and failed import outcomes.
tasks.rationale: Import correctness and error handling need validation against representative spreadsheet data.

modules.name: GDPR & Courier Location Privacy
modules.description: Privacy and compliance controls for courier location data.

tasks.title: Assess GDPR requirements for location data
tasks.description: Identify applicable privacy requirements and define controls for courier location collection, access, retention, and handling.
tasks.rationale: GDPR compliance is explicitly required, but specific retention, access, and processing policies are not provided.

tasks.title: Implement courier location privacy controls
tasks.description: Implement agreed technical controls for courier location data, such as access restrictions and retention or deletion behavior, based on the privacy assessment.
tasks.rationale: Technical controls are needed to support GDPR requirements; exact controls depend on policy and legal review.

tasks.title: Verify location privacy controls
tasks.description: Test access and data-handling controls for courier location data against the agreed privacy requirements.
tasks.rationale: Privacy controls need verification to confirm they behave as specified.

tasks.title: Run end-to-end release regression
tasks.description: Execute end-to-end regression across admin, dispatch, integrations, notifications, courier proof of delivery, reporting, imports, and privacy controls before release.
tasks.rationale: A release-level regression pass is needed to validate interactions across the delivered modules.
